wards.label: Ahmedabad municipal ward map
wards.detail: 48 digitised ward boundaries (441.1 km²) with measured area, perimeter, compactness and OSM road density.

population.label: Modelled from census totals
population.detail: AMC Census 2011 (5,570,585) projected to 2026 at ~2.3%/yr; total distributed by area_km2 x road_density^1.35. Estimates, not ward-level census counts.

parcels.label: OpenStreetMap land polygons
parcels.detail: 2,566 real mapped land boundaries with their real land-use tag (landuse / natural / leisure). These are surveyed blocks and estates, not cadastral title plots — GLIS records are not public. Built-up and vegetation cover are modelled from the tag and local urban intensity.

tenure.label: Ownership — mostly modelled
tenure.detail: Land ownership is not in any public dataset. OpenStreetMap confirms public ownership for only 10 of 2,566 parcels; the rest is modelled from land use and distance to centre. Treat government/private status as indicative, not as a title record.

zoning.label: Official zoning — modelled
zoning.detail: Development-plan zoning sheets are not published in machine-readable form, so the official designation is modelled. Zoning conflicts therefore demonstrate the detection method against real land use; they are not confirmed violations.

facilities.label: OpenStreetMap
facilities.detail: 1252 facilities via the Overpass API, de-duplicated and re-classified (fetched 2026-08-15).

roads.label: OpenStreetMap
roads.detail: 2480 major road segments via the Overpass API, geometry decimated for spatial math.

prediction.label: Growth model output
prediction.detail: Per-cell 2030 growth probability from a transparent weighted model over distance-to-road, distance-to-built-up, distance-to-centre and current land use.
